blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 84214 of the Government Code, as added by Chapter 289 of the Statutes of 1980, is amended to read:

Committees and candidates shall terminate their filing obligation pursuant to regulations adopted by the commission, ensuring that the committee or candidate will have no activity that must be disclosed pursuant to this chapter subsequent to the termination. Such regulations shall not require the filing of any campaign statements other than those required by this chapter. A committee that qualifies solely under subdivision (b) or (c) of Section 82013 shall not be required to file any notice of its termination.
digest: The Political Reform Act of 1974 provides for the comprehensive regulation of campaign financing, including requiring the filing of reports of contributions and expenditures. The act requires committees and candidates to terminate their filing obligation, as provided by the Fair Political Practices Commission by regulation, ensuring that the committee or candidate will have no activity that must be disclosed subsequent to the termination.
This bill would make nonsubstantive changes to that provision.
label: Introduced
subject: Political Reform Act of 1974: committee termination.
title: An act to amend Section 84214 of the Government Code, relating to the Political Reform Act of 1974.
